name: Mexico City
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: -30 to -40 in eastern/northern lakebed bowls (up to -50 historically)
literature_sources: Chaussard et al. (2014), Remote Sensing of Environment
agreement_note: Coherence is high (63.9% valid), so under-estimation (-4.4 cm LOS / -6.2 cm vertical est. over 120 d vs -30 to -40 cm/yr) is caused by in-basin primary reference (-99.013E, 19.587N in Ecatepec/Texcoco), clipped 0.35x0.35 deg bbox cutting off Chalco/eastern Texcoco, and plane deramp. Re-referencing to SW volcanic edge yields -7.4 cm LOS (-10.4 cm vert est., ratio 0.68).
press_summary_gate_note: Exclude -4.4 cm from press summary until PC10 re-runs with +/-0.25 deg bbox and off-basin volcanic bedrock reference.

first_nisar_measurement.evidence: NASA-JPL already released preliminary NISAR L-band InSAR subsidence results for Mexico City (Oct 2025-Jan 2026 acquisitions, >2 cm/month). Cannot claim first NISAR measurement.
first_nisar_measurement.atlas_first_claim_note: Multi-basin standardized atlas phrasing must use qualified (to our knowledge) only after excluding Mexico City from any individual-first claim.
